description: This file defines classes related to SQL Lab models in Apache Superset, including panels, tabs, query contexts, and error handling.

classes.name: Panel
classes.description: Represents a panel with an ID in SQL Lab.

classes.name: Tab
classes.description: Represents a tab in SQL Lab with properties like ID, title, database, schema, panels, and an editor getter.

classes.name: CTAS
classes.description: Represents a Create Table As (CTAS) configuration, either as a view or table.

classes.name: QueryContext
classes.description: Base class for query context, including client ID, tab, async flag, start time, and template parameters.

classes.name: QueryResultContext
classes.description: Extends QueryContext to include query results, execution details, and limits.

classes.name: QueryErrorResultContext
classes.description: Extends QueryContext to handle query errors, including error messages and associated errors.

methods.name: getEditor
methods.description: Returns a promise resolving to the editor instance via the editorGetter.
